lines: Most notetakers wait for a meeting link.
A meeting in a room doesn't have one, so nobody writes down what was decided.
Here's the fix: record it in your browser at lynkk.ai.
Open lynkk.ai on your laptop, and put it in the middle of the table.
A short countdown, and Lynkk is recording your mic.
Pause when you need to. If the room goes quiet, it warns you.
When you stop, Lynkk writes the transcript with speaker labels, in 17 languages.
Then a Meeting Brief: key takeaways, decisions, open questions, and action items with an owner, a due date and a priority.
The Meeting Brief is on the free plan.
Every timestamp plays the recording from that moment.
Share the note with a link, and the summary is emailed to you after every meeting.
Send action items to Jira from the note, one issue each.
Record your next in-person meeting, and Lynkk never trains on your conversations.
